name: Angel
summary: Something larger than you, looking on or lending a hand.
across: Watching over two lovers, pouring between cups, sounding a trumpet, carved small on royal thrones.

name: Anubis
summary: A jackal-headed guide rising with the wheel: what goes down comes back up.
across: Only on the Wheel, riding its rising side upward while the snake slides down the other.

name: Archway
summary: A way through, into something built.
across: A garden gate past an offered coin, a carved arch at work, a family’s stone gateway.

name: Banner
summary: A message carried high for everyone to see.
across: Flown by a pale rider, a child on horseback, a trumpet’s angel, and a camp of tents.

name: Bed
summary: Rest, and where worries come at night.
across: Only in the Nine of Swords: a rose quilt, a carved frame, someone sitting up awake.

name: Bird
summary: A small, free voice, often easy to miss.
across: A bird in a tree, a descending dove, a windblown flock, a hooded falcon at rest.

name: Blindfold
summary: Not seeing, by choice or not: what you can’t or won’t look at yet.
across: Two blindfolded figures: one holding crossed swords still, one standing loosely bound among blades.

name: Boat
summary: Crossing over: carrying something from one shore to the next.
across: A ferry of quiet passengers, ships watched from a ledge, and ships pitching on high waves.

name: Bridge
summary: A way across, back or forward.
across: A small bridge toward a celebration, and one still standing behind a figure grieving spilled cups.

name: Bull
summary: Steady, stubborn strength, rooted in the earth.
across: Bull heads carved into a royal throne, among grapes and gardens, holding the seat steady.

name: Bundle
summary: What you carry with you, and how much of it you need.
across: Just on the Fool: a small pack slung on a stick, light enough for the road.

name: Butterfly
summary: Change that comes after waiting.
across: Worked into a crown and carved on a throne, in the court of swords.

name: Black cat
summary: Independence and quiet watchfulness.
across: Only at the Queen of Wands, sitting black and alert at the throne’s foot.

name: Chains and bonds
summary: What holds you, and how tightly it really does.
across: Loose chains around two horned figures, and loose cloth bindings around someone among swords.

name: Child
summary: Openness, play, and something new beginning.
across: A child looking up at death, riding bareback in sunlight, rising at a trumpet, handing over flowers.

name: Cloud
summary: Weather passing over: worry, mystery, or a change coming.
across: Offering a hand on every Ace, storming over a pierced heart, torn behind a charging knight.

name: Crayfish
summary: Something rising from the deep, half-formed, not yet sure it wants the light.
across: Only in the Moon, climbing half out of a pool toward a long path.

name: Cross
summary: Where two directions meet: heaven and earth, spirit and matter.
across: On a priestess’s chest, a triple staff, a flag on a trumpet, a dove’s wafer.

name: Crown
summary: Authority, and the weight that comes with it.
across: Starry, flowered or flame-shaped on rulers, then fallen under a pale rider and toppled from a tower.

name: Cup
summary: Feelings, and what you hold, offer, or receive.
across: Poured between hands, raised in a toast, spilled in grief, stacked and left behind.

name: Dance
summary: Moving with life instead of against it.
across: A dancer in a wreath, friends raising cups, children at play, a juggler light on the feet.

name: Dew
summary: Quiet nourishment that falls whether or not you notice it.
across: Drops falling from a moon, an offered cup, a raised sword, even a struck tower.

name: Dog
summary: Instinct and loyalty: the tame, companion part of you.
across: The same dog-shaped instinct, in a leap, a howl and a family garden.

name: Dragon
summary: A fear, or a desire, grown bigger than life.
across: Only in the Seven of Cups, rising out of one cup among many daydreams.

name: Face
summary: Someone looking back at you: another person, or yourself.
across: A face in the moon, a smiling sun, a head in a cup, a watching moon.

name: Feather
summary: Lightness and a free spirit, worn where it shows.
across: A plume on a wanderer, a sunlit child, and knights riding hard with feathers streaming.

name: Fire
summary: Heat that warms, transforms, or burns.
across: A tree of flames behind lovers, a torch held low, a bolt setting a tower alight.

name: Fish
summary: Ideas and feelings rising from deep water.
across: Peeking from a cup held up to look at, and leaping from the sea beside a throne.

name: Flowers
summary: Roses, lilies and garlands: tenderness, growth, a heart left open.
across: A rose in a wanderer’s hand, a lion’s garland, sunflowers by a wall, roses quilting a sleepless bed.

name: The four creatures
summary: Angel, eagle, lion and bull in the corners: every part of life, watching over.
across: In the corners of the Wheel, reading their books, and again around the World’s dancer.

name: Garden
summary: Something tended over time until it gives back.
across: A magician’s roses, a walled sunflower garden, heavy vines tended by hand, a rich estate of grapes.

name: Globe
summary: The whole world held in one hand: reach, and responsibility.
across: An orb held by rulers, one topping a scepter, a globe studied from a high wall.

name: Halo
summary: A light around the head: grace, or a moment of insight.
across: Glowing around a head hung upside down, and on the brow of a winged figure pouring water.

name: Hand from a cloud
summary: A gift offered from beyond what you can see. Every Ace has one.
across: On each Ace offering a wand, cup, sword or coin, and once a cup that goes unnoticed.

name: Harvest
summary: What has grown, ripened, and is ready to be gathered.
across: Ripe wheat, grapes in a raised hand, a heavy vine under study, a pumpkin at dancing feet.

name: Heart
summary: Feeling at its most direct, where hurt and love both land.
across: A heart-shaped shield resting by a soft throne, and a heart pierced by three blades in rain.

name: Heights and edges
summary: Cliffs, peaks and high ground: a wider view, and the step that comes next.
across: A cliff edge, a lantern on a snowy peak, a ledge above the sea, far pyramids.

name: Horse
summary: Movement and drive: how fast, and who is steering.
across: A pale horse walking, a white horse in victory, knights’ horses rearing, galloping, or standing still.

name: House
summary: Home, family, and what you’ve built to shelter in.
across: A city left behind, a house ahead of a heavy load, a home under a rainbow.

name: Infinity
summary: The sideways eight: energy that keeps renewing itself.
across: Floating over a magician’s head, over someone calming a lion, and looping two juggled coins.

name: Jewels
summary: Riches and glitter: what dazzles, and whether it lasts.
across: Only in the Seven of Cups, heaped in one dream cup among many.

name: Keys
summary: Access: what is open to you, and who decides.
across: Only with the Hierophant: two crossed keys at the foot of the seat, before two kneeling figures.

name: Lantern
summary: A small light, enough for the next step.
across: Only with the Hermit, raised high on a snowy peak, lighting a lonely climb.

name: Lightning
summary: A sudden flash that changes everything it touches.
across: Only in the Tower, striking the top and knocking the crown loose.

name: Lion
summary: Raw strength and passion, wild or gently held.
across: Gently held by the jaws, carved on fiery thrones, and winged above two cups meeting.

name: Moon
summary: Reflected light: dreams, intuition, and what is only half seen.
across: At a priestess’s feet, on a charioteer’s shoulders, a face in the night, watching someone leave.

name: Path
summary: The way forward, even when you can't see where it ends.
across: Winding up to a distant sun, between a dog and a wolf, and out through a garden archway.

name: Pentacle
summary: The body, money and daily life: things you can hold.
across: Held to the chest, carved one by one, juggled in loops, and glowing in a lit window.

name: Pillars
summary: A threshold between two opposites, like light and dark.
across: Dark and light flanking a priestess, gray behind a teacher, stone behind a judge, towers beyond death.

name: Pitchers
summary: Pouring out what you hold.
across: Only in the Star: two pitchers, one pouring into the pool, one onto the land.

name: Pomegranates
summary: Many seeds in one fruit: hidden richness, waiting.
across: Only in the High Priestess, patterned across the veil hanging behind the seat.

name: Rabbit
summary: Abundance, close to the ground.
across: Only with the Queen of Pentacles, a small rabbit in the corner of a lush garden.

name: Rainbow
summary: A promise after the storm.
across: Only in the Ten of Cups, a rainbow of cups arching over a home and a family.

name: Ram
summary: Drive and will, head first.
across: Only with the Emperor, ram heads carved into a stone throne in bare mountains.

name: Salamander
summary: The lizard of fire legend: passion that survives the heat.
across: Patterned on two tunics in the suit of fire, and curled at the foot of a throne.

name: Scales
summary: Weighing things fairly: give and take, cause and effect.
across: Held up in Justice’s hand, and weighing out coins for those asking for help.

name: Sceptre
summary: The power to direct, and how it's used.
across: Raised high by one ruler, resting in another’s hand, triple-crossed for a teacher, steady above the waves.

name: Scroll
summary: Knowledge, partly shown and partly kept back.
across: Half hidden in a priestess’s lap, and held up as plans among builders.

name: Serpent
summary: Change and renewal, or temptation, depending on where it coils.
across: Coiled in a tree, sliding down a wheel, belted around a magician, rising from a cup.

name: Skull
summary: Endings, and the bare bones of things.
across: A skeleton riding in black armor, and a quieter glimpse among the dream cups.

name: Snow
summary: A cold, hard season, and the hope that it passes.
across: A snowy peak under a lone lantern, and bare feet in falling snow outside a lit window.

name: Sphinx
summary: A riddle to answer, and balance held still.
across: Two sphinxes, dark and light, before a chariot, and one calm atop the wheel holding a sword.

name: Star
summary: Hope, and guidance from far away.
across: A crown of stars, a starry canopy, a star in a lantern, and eight over a pool.

name: Sun
summary: Clarity, warmth, and things out in the open.
across: Behind a wanderer at the edge, above lovers, rising between towers, and smiling down on a child.

name: Sword
summary: Thought and words: they can cut through, or cut.
across: Held upright for fairness, piercing a heart, laid on a tomb, raised into the wind.

name: Table
summary: What you have laid out in front of you to work with.
across: Tools laid out for a magician, a draped table of full cups, a workbench for carving coins.

name: Tents
summary: A camp: somewhere temporary.
across: Only in the Seven of Swords, a camp someone tiptoes away from with an armful of blades.

name: Throne
summary: A seat of steady power: where you rule from.
across: Carved with rams, lions, butterflies or bulls, set in stone, among roses, or on waves.

name: Tomb
summary: A resting place: deep rest, or something laid down for good.
across: A figure resting on a tomb under stained glass, and figures rising from open coffins.

name: Torch
summary: A fierce light that can guide or burn.
across: Only with the Devil, held downward, touching the tail of a chained figure.

name: Tower
summary: Something built: shelter, a boundary, or a gate.
across: A struck tower, two towers framing a moonlit path, castles on hills, and a city left behind.

name: Tree
summary: Roots and growth over time.
across: A fruit tree with a serpent, a living beam to hang from, trees bent flat by wind.

name: Trumpet
summary: A call you can’t ignore.
across: Only in Judgement, blown from the clouds as the graves open below.

name: Veil
summary: What is just out of view, for now.
across: A veil behind a priestess, a curtain behind a judge, a shrouded figure, a draped table.

name: Wands and staffs
summary: Energy, will, and something to lean on.
across: Leaned on, sprouting leaves, hauled as a heavy load, flying through the air, or clashing in a tangle.

name: Water
summary: Feelings and the unconscious: still, pouring, or deep.
across: Poured onto land, crossed by ferry, rippling under a throne, and calm beyond a fallen figure.

name: Wheel
summary: Cycles: what turns, and what comes round again.
across: Only on the Wheel of Fortune, turning in the sky with creatures riding its rim.

name: Window
summary: Warmth and help, seen from outside.
across: Stained glass over someone resting, and a lit window above two figures in the snow.

name: Wings
summary: Rising above, or something carried on the air.
across: A winged disk on a chariot, a winged lion over two cups, a rider’s winged helmet.

name: Wolf
summary: The wild instinct that won't be tamed.
across: Only in the Moon, howling up at the night beside its tame cousin, the dog.

name: Wreath
summary: Recognition, and the circle of a victory.
across: Around a dancer, on a rider’s head in triumph, looped around a lion, offered in a cup.
